title: ui.md file-name rule conflicts with the CLI render file names now written straight into renders/

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261128-002826-1170e384 for S660. `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md:75-81` still asks the UI role for `VIEW-80x24.txt`, `VIEW-120x40.txt` and `VIEW-ascii.txt`. The brief's render commands now write straight into `renders/` under their own names:

- The CLI command writes `NAME.txt` (`internal/engine/brief.go:239-241`).
- The TUI command writes `NAME-80x24.txt`, `NAME-120x40.txt` and `NAME-ascii.txt` (`internal/engine/brief.go:246`).

So the prompt and the brief disagree about file names. Separately, the fallback at `ui.md:70-71` applies only when the brief has neither render section. `brief.go:248-256` already writes the `## Renders` fallback when either section is missing.

The defaults write 5 CLI files and 15 TUI files, 20 in all. `-render-fixture` and `-render-size` can pass `maxRenders = 24` (`internal/engine/approval.go:405`), and the card drops the rest. Neither the prompt nor the brief says so.

Owner decision adj 680 (`ui.render-file-cap`, `reword-warn`): reword `ui.md` so `VIEW-WxH` naming applies only to views the brief's render sections do not cover, and CLI files keep `NAME.txt`. Tell the UI role in `ui.md` and in the brief's render paragraphs to keep at most 24 files. `maxRenders` stays 24.

Owner decision, 2026-11-28: adj 680 (reword naming; warn about the 24-file cap; either-section fallback).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestUIPromptNamesTheOutOfTreeRenderRoute (`internal/roles/roles_test.go`, existing, edited). It now asserts the fallback sentence applies when either render section is missing. It looks for "When the brief has no `## TUI renders` section or no `## CLI text renders` section, follow its `## Renders` section" and no longer looks for the old "has no ... or ... section" wording. Red today: `ui.md:70` has the old wording.
- TestUIPromptLimitsVIEWNamesToUncoveredViews (`internal/roles/roles_test.go`, new). In the Renders part of the prompt (cut at `## Finding kinds`):
  - It names `NAME.txt` as the CLI file name and `NAME-80x24.txt`, `NAME-120x40.txt` and `NAME-ascii.txt` as the TUI file names, and says to leave them as the brief's commands write them.
  - It says `VIEW-80x24.txt`, `VIEW-120x40.txt` and `VIEW-ascii.txt` are for views the brief's render sections do not cover.
  - It tells the role to keep at most 24 files in the renders directory, counting the files the brief's commands write.
  - The prompt stays ASCII (the existing ASCII test still runs).
  - Red today: `ui.md:75-81` asks for `VIEW-` names for every view and has no cap warning.
- TestUIPassBriefNamesTheRenderFileCap (`internal/engine/brief_test.go`, new). Table over `uiBriefBody` with cli/tui = (true,true), (true,false), (false,true), (false,false). Each section that is present (`CLI text renders`, `TUI renders`, `Renders`) contains "at most 24 files". The CLI section still contains "ork's approval card lists every `.txt` file in the renders directory". Red today: no section names the cap.
- TestUIPassBriefListsEveryRenderFixture (`internal/cli/render_test.go:573`) is not edited. It must still pass: its end marker `. ork's approval card lists every `.txt` file in the renders directory` stays in the CLI paragraph.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md`, reword lines 70-71 to: "When the brief has no `## TUI renders` section or no `## CLI text renders` section, follow its `## Renders` section and the project's own tooling for the views that section names." Keep the phrase "follow its `## Renders` section and the project's own tooling".
2. In `ui.md`, replace the lead-in at lines 75-81. Say the brief's render commands name their own files, and the role leaves those names as they are:
   - `NAME.txt` for CLI views.
   - `NAME-80x24.txt`, `NAME-120x40.txt` and `NAME-ascii.txt` for TUI views.
   Then say that for each view the diff adds or changes that the brief's render sections do not cover (the `## Renders` fallback), the role writes `VIEW-80x24.txt`, `VIEW-120x40.txt` and `VIEW-ascii.txt` with the three descriptions that are there now. Keep the `VIEW` naming sentence (letters, digits and `-`, plain text, no color codes) and the tree-unchanged sentence.
3. In `ui.md:85-86`, replace "ork keeps up to 24 files, 24 KiB each, and only `.txt` files that are not links." with a sentence that does two things:
   - It keeps the existing facts: ork keeps up to 24 files of 24 KiB each, and only `.txt` files that are not links.
   - It adds: "Keep at most 24 files in the renders directory in all, counting the files the brief's render commands write. ork's card drops the rest. When the fixtures you need would pass 24, render fewer and say in your report which views you left out."
4. In `ui.md:89-93`, keep the short-height bullet. Add that a TUI view in the brief's `## TUI renders` section gets its extra size from `-render-size WxH`, which writes `NAME-WxH.txt`, and that `VIEW-WxH.txt` is for views the brief's render sections do not cover. Keep the strings "only shows below 80x24", "the height the tests use for that view", "name the size in your report" and "VIEW-WxH.txt".
5. In `internal/engine/brief.go`, make three edits so each paragraph names the cap. The other text stays as it is:
   - In the CLI paragraph (line 241), append after "ork's approval card lists every `.txt` file in the renders directory.": " Keep at most 24 files in the renders directory in all, counting the TUI renders; the card drops the rest, so pick fixtures that keep the total at 24 or fewer."
   - In the TUI paragraph (line 246), append at the end: "The default fixtures write 15 files. Keep at most 24 files in the renders directory in all, counting the CLI renders; the card drops the rest, so pick fixtures and sizes that keep the total at 24 or fewer."
   - In the `## Renders` fallback format string (line 255), append: " Keep at most 24 files in the renders directory in all; the card drops the rest."
6. Update `TestUIPromptNamesTheOutOfTreeRenderRoute` to the new fallback wording. Add `TestUIPromptLimitsVIEWNamesToUncoveredViews` in `internal/roles/roles_test.go`, reusing the `has` and `prompts` helpers. Add `TestUIPassBriefNamesTheRenderFileCap` in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`, reusing `uiBriefBody`. Run each new test and see it fail before the prompt and brief edits.
7. In `docs/design.md:850-852` and `docs/guide.md:1025-1027`, after "the approval card lists every `.txt` file there", add one sentence. The UI brief and prompt tell the role to keep at most 24 files in `renders/`, counting the CLI and TUI files together, because the card keeps 24 (`maxRenders`). `VIEW-` names are for views the brief's render sections do not cover. Add nothing to `docs/state.md` or `docs/dashboard.md`.
8. Run `slicer changelog add S665 --text "..." --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork`. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`. Do not change `maxRenders`, `internal/engine/approval.go` or any golden.

The UI brief's CLI, TUI and fallback paragraphs say the same cap. maxRenders is still 24.
